title: 第8章 我记住你了！
slug: 史上第一祖师爷全本免费-史上第一祖师爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
先示敌以弱，诱得叶葛冒进之后，果断以最强力量迎击，将这个流光剑宗的筑基期修士打得满脸桃花开。
但老桃树自己也付出了不小代价，她那一身艳红的护体妖光此刻也消失不见，只能以红雾花雨来组织起新的攻势。
就算这样，也不是重伤的叶葛三人可以抵挡，叶葛三人连忙逃窜。
就在这时，另一个方向上，突然爆发出一阵强烈的法力波动，雷电狂涌，惊心动魄。
林锋脸色苍白，大汗淋漓。
在他的头顶，北极天磁剑悬浮于半空中，剑身上布满雷霆电弧，火花不停跳动，“滋滋滋滋”电流声狂响。
林锋手捏法诀，嘴里发苦：“这东西太耗费法力了，但这还远远不够啊。”他感觉自己一身法力几乎都要被北极天磁剑抽空了。
林锋的机会不多，趁着老桃树被叶葛严重消耗之际，是击败老桃树最好的机会，过了这村，就没这店了。
突然，林锋福至心灵：“对了，我怎么忘了那东西？”
他连忙取出天雷玉魄，尝试从中抽取雷电灵气。
这一下险些惹祸，天雷玉魄中的雷电精华何等精纯，何等庞大，一瞬间涌进林锋体内，差点把他电成焦炭。
林锋整个人都被雷电覆盖，浑身上下遍布密密麻麻的青紫雷光。
别说五官七窍中火花四溅，就是周身毛孔中都有容纳不了的雷电灵气喷出。
千钧一发之际，林锋将自身九霄天雷正法运转到了极致，心神沟通头顶的北极天磁剑。
庞大的雷电灵气终于有了渲泄的出口，立刻如同洪水决堤般冲入北极天磁剑中。
林锋小心翼翼的控制体内法力灵气的流动，让自身变成天雷玉魄和北极天磁剑之间沟通的桥梁。
有了天雷玉魄这记大补，北极天磁剑顿时威猛起来，剑身上的雷光越发凝炼，最后化为一片纯白，连同北极天磁剑自身都化作一柄光剑。
光剑剑尖上，雷光汇聚成一个雷球，体积越来越大，流露出毁天灭地的威势，比起林锋之前九天动雷引召唤的天雷，也是只强不弱。
这个雷球的恐怖，已经可以和老桃树凝结的那个光球相媲美了。
林锋这边的动静已经惊动了战局中的众人，双方都惊疑不定的停手，虽然看不见林锋，但都在关注林锋这边的动向。

可不等他们做出反应，林锋已经出手。
一束无比霸道，无比强横的璀璨雷光，轰然划过天际，劈向焦黑的老桃树。
北极天磁神光！
桃树花枝剧烈颤抖起来，无穷红雾，无穷花雨迎向北极天磁神光。
雷光与花雨红雾在半空中相遇，时光仿佛在这一刻凝聚，变得无限缓慢，明明只是一刹那，却仿佛沧海百年。
围观每一个人都发现，自己可以清楚的看到花雨和红雾一点一点的碎裂，变为点点尘埃，继而被雷光吞噬。
妖艳的花枝，一寸一寸，一尺一尺，全部如同飞灰一般，全部碎裂。
最后是八九米高，直径足有十几米的老桃树本身，也如同破碎的瓷器一般，布满裂纹。
碎裂，碎裂，不停的碎裂，再碎裂！
无数焦黑的木炭碎块掉落在地面上，这株庞大无比的老桃树，直接被林锋这一记北极天磁神光劈的粉碎！
可怜它之前便遭过一次雷击，现在又遭雷劫，再也抗不过去了。
林锋看见自己这一剑的成果，长舒一口气，精神一振虚弱，他是没能力再来一次了。
海量雷电灵气经由他的身体注入北极天磁剑，使得他的身体也承受巨大负担，尤其是心脏，阵阵发麻。
但他很快振作起精神，因为他隐隐约约看到，在老桃树被劈碎后，有个白色光影一闪而过。
虽然惊鸿一瞥，但林锋脸色大变。
那是一个赤着双足，白衣胜雪的女子，其美貌是林锋生平仅见。
慕容嫣然已经可以算是绝色，但在这女子面前也要略逊一筹。
这个女子的美，美在全身上下没有一点瑕疵，美的惊心动魄，美的令人沉迷……美的不像人类。
可是林锋心中却没有以往见到美女的火热感觉。
他只感到彻骨的寒意，后背冷汗直冒。

白衣女子披散着头发，浑身上下没有任何饰物，但却自然而然流露出一股惑人的美态。
林锋感到她向自己这边望了一眼，耳边又响起那低沉沙哑的女声。

content_en:
After showing the enemy weakness first and luring Ye Ge to rush forward, he decisively attacked with the strongest force, beating this foundation-building monk of the Flowing Light Sword Sect until his face was full of peach blossoms.
But Lao Taoshu herself also paid a heavy price. Her bright red body-protecting demon light also disappeared at this moment, and she could only use the red mist and flower rain to organize a new offensive.
Even so, the seriously injured Ye Ge and the others could not resist, so the Ye Ge and the others quickly fled.
At this moment, a burst of strong mana fluctuations suddenly erupted in the other direction, and thunder and lightning surged wildly, which was thrilling.
Lin Feng's face was pale and he was sweating profusely.
Above his head, the North Pole Sky Magnetic Sword was suspended in mid-air. The sword was covered with thunder arcs, sparks kept beating, and the electric current sounded wildly.
Lin Feng squeezed the magic formula with his hands and his mouth was bitter: "This thing consumes too much mana, but it is not enough." He felt that almost all his mana was drained by the Arctic Sky Magnetic Sword.
Lin Feng didn't have many opportunities. Taking advantage of the situation when Old Peach Tree was seriously consumed by Ye Ge was the best chance to defeat Old Peach Tree. After passing this village, there would be no more shops.
Suddenly, Lin Feng thought in his heart: "By the way, why did I forget that thing?"
He quickly took out the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul and tried to extract the lightning spiritual energy from it.
This time he almost caused trouble. The lightning essence in the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul was so pure and huge. It poured into Lin Feng's body in an instant and almost electrocuted him into coke.
Lin Feng's entire body was covered by lightning, and his whole body was covered with dense purple lightning.
Not to mention sparks flying from the five senses and seven orifices, there was even more thunder and lightning spiritual energy spurting out from the pores all over his body.
At the critical moment, Lin Feng activated his Nine Heavens Thunder Zhengfa to the extreme, communicating with the North Pole Sky Magnetic Sword above his head.
The huge thunder and lightning spiritual energy finally had an outlet to vent, and it immediately rushed into the Arctic Magnetic Sword like a flood breaking through a bank.
Lin Feng carefully controlled the flow of mana and spiritual energy in his body, making himself a bridge of communication between the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul and the North Pole Heavenly Magnetic Sword.
With the help of the Heavenly Thunder Jade Soul, the Arctic Magnetic Sword suddenly became more powerful. The lightning on the sword became more and more condensed, and finally turned into pure white, and the Arctic Magnetic Sword itself turned into a lightsaber.
On the tip of the lightsaber, the lightning converged into a thunder ball, which grew larger and larger, revealing the power of destroying the world and destroying the world. It was no weaker than the sky thunder summoned by Lin Feng's previous nine-day thunder trigger.
The terror of this thunder ball is comparable to that of the ball of light condensed by the old peach tree.
The movement on Lin Feng's side has alarmed everyone in the battle. Both sides stopped in surprise. Although they couldn't see Lin Feng, they were all paying attention to the movement on Lin Feng's side.
But before they could react, Lin Feng had already taken action.
A beam of extremely domineering and powerful bright lightning flashed across the sky and struck at the charred old peach tree.
Arctic Magnetic Divine Light!
The branches of the peach trees trembled violently, and endless red mist and endless rain of flowers greeted the magnetic light of the North Pole.
Thunder light and flower rain and red mist met in mid-air, and time seemed to condense at this moment, becoming infinitely slow. It was obviously only a moment, but it seemed like a century-long journey.
Everyone who was watching found that they could clearly see the flower rain and the red mist shattering bit by bit, turning into bits of dust, and then being swallowed up by the lightning.
The enchanting flower branches, inch by inch, foot by foot, were all broken like flying ash.
Finally, the old peach tree itself, which is eight to nine meters high and more than ten meters in diameter, is like broken porcelain, full of cracks.
Break, break, break, break again!
Countless pieces of charred charcoal fell to the ground, and this huge old peach tree was directly smashed to pieces by Lin Feng's arctic magnetic light!
Unfortunately, it had been struck by lightning once before, and now it was struck by lightning again, and it could no longer withstand it.
When Lin Feng saw the results of his sword, he breathed a long sigh of relief and felt weak. He didn't have the ability to do it again.
Massive thunder and lightningThe spiritual energy was injected into the Arctic Sky Magnetic Sword through his body, causing his body to bear a huge burden, especially his heart, which was numb.
But he quickly cheered up, because he vaguely saw a white light flashing past the old peach tree after it was chopped into pieces.
Although he had a startling glance, Lin Feng's expression changed drastically.
It was a woman with bare feet and white clothes, whose beauty was the only one Lin Feng had ever seen in his life.
Murong Yanran can be regarded as stunning, but she is still a little inferior in front of this woman.
The beauty of this woman, there is no flaw in the whole body, the beauty is breathtaking, the beauty is addictive... the beauty is not like a human being.
But Lin Feng didn't have the burning feeling in his heart that he had when seeing beautiful women in the past.
He only felt a bone-chilling chill, and cold sweat broke out on his back.
The woman in white wears her hair loose and has no accessories on her body, but she naturally exudes a charming beauty.
Lin Feng felt her glance towards him, and the low and hoarse female voice sounded in his ears again.
